accuracy_and_f1: Stored on scale 0-1. Summary standard deviations use ddof=1 over five seeds.
attribution: Strike-based client flags, separate from traffic classification and temporary suppression.
cumulative: Each distinct client ever flagged through round 50 counts once. Clearing a later flag does not remove prior cumulative detection.
flag_fpr: Distinct benign clients ever flagged divided by the number of benign clients. It is not a traffic-classification FPR.
mean_ttd: Mean first-flag round among detected attackers only. Interpret with recall because undetected attackers are not assigned a finite TTD.
clean_runs: Attacker precision, recall and residual malicious weight are not applicable. Honest flag and suppression rates remain defined for S4.
aggregation_baselines: FedAvg and clipped mean have no client-attribution detector in this implementation. Attribution fields are not applicable.
scope: One 115-32-2 ReLU MLP. Original S4 hyperparameters retained without model-specific retuning. Attacked configurations use three fixed attackers.
